title: Restart policies and recurring failure
summary: Restart policy, exit state and restart count provide lifecycle evidence. Repeated exits can arise from entrypoint failure, unavailable dependencies, permissions, signals or resource pressure.
checks: Correlate bounded exit/restart evidence with application dependency checks and deployment times.
Review restart policy intent independently of current running state.
limitations: A snapshot count is not a rate and exit 137 alone does not prove OOM.
